A Speed Bump challenge is a task that a team must perform before moving onto the rest of the leg. The team who must perform 
this task is one who had been save from elimination at the end of the previous leg, except for the Speed Bump in Season 33. Please NOTE, for the Speed Bump a non-elimination point is a Pit Stop where Phil says it is, and NOT when teams are instructed to continue racing. This spreadsheet does not make a distinction between the two when considering elimination points.
The Speed Bump was introduced in Season 12, as an alternative to taking team's money and possessions at a non-elimination point, but has not been used in Seasons 34, 35, and 36 due to all Pit Stops being elimination points.
